WITH mine AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date AS d, SUM(f.net_amount) AS gross_sales, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS nd
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<900
 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT store_id, business_date d, net_sales_before_returns nb, returns_net, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND store_id<900)
SELECT COALESCE(m.store_id,r.store_id) sid, SUM(m.gross_sales) mine, SUM(r.nb) rpt, SUM(m.gross_sales)-SUM(r.nb) diff, SUM(m.n) lines, SUM(m.nd) dlines, COUNT(m.d) mdays, COUNT(r.d) rdays
FROM mine m FULL JOIN r ON r.store_id=m.store_id AND r.d=m.d
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(SUM(m.gross_sales),0)-COALESCE(SUM(r.nb),0)) DESC

WITH l AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'),
dups AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dups) dup_keys, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c),0) FROM dups) dup_rows, (SELECT MIN(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) mn, (SELECT MAX(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) mx, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM l) ndist

WITH m AS (SELECT f.sale_date d, SUM(f.net_amount) a, COUNT(*) n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=116 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.d, m.a, r.net_sales_before_returns b, m.a-r.net_sales_before_returns diff, m.n, r.receipts FROM m JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.store_id=116 AND r.business_date=m.d ORDER BY 1

WITH ret AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, r.return_date d, r.return_line_id, r.sales_line_id, r.refund_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(refund_net) m, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) nd, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ns FROM ret GROUP BY 1),
rp AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(returns_net) r FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(mine.store_id, rp.store_id) sid, mine.m, rp.r, mine.m-rp.r diff, mine.n, mine.nd, mine.ns FROM mine FULL JOIN rp ON rp.store_id=mine.store_id WHERE ABS(COALESCE(mine.m,0)-COALESCE(rp.r,0))>0.001 OR mine.n<>mine.nd OR mine.n<>mine.ns

WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.etl_loaded_at, f.sales_line_id) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.rn = 1 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, SUM(r.refund_net) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
tdays AS (
  SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
  FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN dim_date d
  WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
    AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
    AND d.is_trading_day
    AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= d.calendar_date)
    AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= d.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(sa.sales_net,0) - COALESCE(re.returns_net,0)) / t.trading_days DESC) AS rank,
       cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(sa.sales_net,0) - COALESCE(re.returns_net,0), 2) AS net_sales,
       t.trading_days,
       ROUND((COALESCE(sa.sales_net,0) - COALESCE(re.returns_net,0)) / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM dim_store cs JOIN tdays t ON t.store_id = cs.store_id LEFT JOIN sales sa ON sa.store_id = cs.store_id LEFT JOIN rets re ON re.store_id = cs.store_id
WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
ORDER BY rank
